messages:
nora: new office tradition proposal: Rubber Duck Court. when in doubt, bring the duck to the problem and present your case. :duck:

kevin: official? do we need robes or just dramatic pauses?

alesha: robes would be overkill but i'm not opposed. also the duck needs a proper name. suggestions?

milo: Ducky McJudge? The Honorable Quack? Judge Quackers?

nora: vote with emoji: :duck: for Ducky McJudge, :gavel: for Judge Quackers, :star: for The Honorable Quack.

kevin: :duck:

alesha: :gavel:

nora: :duck: wins. Ducky McJudge it is.

milo: rules idea: anyone can summon Ducky McJudge by leaving it on the whiteboard and saying "I present Exhibit A". then you explain your bug/idea for 2 minutes without interruption.

alesha: requirement: no devices during your 2 minutes. pure duck court listening.

ops-bot: Reminder: shared objects should be kept tidy. Please return Ducky McJudge to the shelf after sessions and avoid placing it near power strips. :robot_face:

kevin: ceremonial perks? winner of the best plea gets a sticker and the ability to pick office coffee for a day.

nora: sticker-bot, can you make a "Ducky Advocate" sticker?

sticker-bot: :sparkles: "Ducky Advocate" sticker created and added to #lore-cabinet. :sparkles:

milo: inaugural court scheduled for Wednesday 10:30. i will be bringing Exhibit A (a reproducible race-condition). dramatic tones optional.

alesha: i will make a tiny gavel out of an unused post-it roll for ambience.

kevin: closing that the court will be community-run and consent-based. no forced theatrical punishments unless unanimously approved.

nora: official log: "2177777777 - Ducky McJudge established. Court opening Wednesday 10:30. May our bugs be small and our coffee strong." :scroll:
